wallet-genesis.http.contents: Complete raw response (status line, headers, body) to the tool's own query for the genesis block address, captured live by H5 for issue #337 with the tool's User-Agent. chain_stats: 67,114 transactions, funded_txo_sum 5768738760 satoshis, spent 0; mempool_stats separate (1 unconfirmed transaction, 3672 satoshis).

wallet-invalid.http.contents: Complete raw response to a query for the genesis address with its last character changed (a bad checksum), captured live by H5 for issue #337. The source answers HTTP 400 with the plain text body 'Invalid Bitcoin address': the refusal shape the tool reports as a failed fetch, never as figures.

wallet-unused-empty.http.contents: Complete raw response to the tool's own query for a never used address, captured live by H5 for issue #337. The address was constructed locally by H5 (base58check over a hash160 derived from a fixture seed string; no one holds a key for it in this project) and the capture verifies the empty shape against the live source: every figure in chain_stats and mempool_stats is 0.
